items.Description: This recall involves CHE-US magnetic stick figure toys. The robot-shaped toys were sold in sets of five or 10 purple, blue, yellow, red and green stick figures. Each stick figure has four small magnets, one in each hand and foot. “X004N3MGCB” is printed on the back of the product packaging.

Hazards.Name: The recalled magnetic stick figures violate the mandatory standard for toys because when pulled apart, the figures’ arms and legs liberate high-powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.

Images.Caption: Recalled CHE-US Magnetic Robot Stick Figures
“X004N3MGCB” is printed on the back of the CHE-US magnetic robot stick figures’ product packaging.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the stick figures immediately, take them away from children and contact CHE-US for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the toys in the trash to CHE-USMagneticRobotToysRecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from April 2025 through August 2026 for between t $9 and $18.

items.Description:
Washington, D.C. -- The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and Guangzhouyupinkejiyouxiangongsi (Guangzhou Yupin Technology Co., Ltd) dba Xentrawave, of China, are announcing the recall of the Xentrawave adult portable bed rails, models XT016 (all batches) and XT026 (batch number 20251212).  

The adult portable bed rails fail to meet mandatory standard requirements, because users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. In addition, the XT016 model adult bed rail does not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing entrapment hazards, and its push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard.  

CPSC has received one report of a death involving the Xentrawave adult portable bed rail, model XT016. In 2026, an 89-year-old woman died from asphyxiation after she became entrapped between the bed rail and mattress.   

About 2,114 adult portable bed rails were sold in the United States.  

The recalled bed rails were sold under the “Xentrawave” brand and under two model names, models “XT016” and “XT026”. The recall of the XT016 applies to all batch numbers, and the recall of XT026 model applies only to batch number “20251212”. The “Xentrawave” brand name is printed on a green label located on the bed rail’s grey fabric pouch. The model numbers “XT016” or “XT026” are located on the front of the product’s outer packaging and the first page of the instruction manual. The batch number “20251212” for the XT026 model is located on the product label attached to the back of the bed rail’s gray fabric pouch and in the instruction manual. The recalled bed rails have black or gray metal frames, gray foam rubber handle grips, and gray fabric pouches. The XT016 model measures about 12.2 inches wide by 25.5 inches high and the XT026 model measures about 12.2 inches wide by 21.5 inches high.  

The adult portable bed rails were sold by Xentrawave at Amazon.com. The XT016 bed rails were sold from May 2025 through March 2026 and the XT026 bed rails were sold from March 2026 through August 2026 for between $37 and $40.  


The adult portable bed rails were imported by Guangzhouyupinkejiyouxiangongsi (Guangzhou Yupin Technology Co., Ltd) dba Xentrawave, of China and manufactured by Guangzhou Nanyu Medical Technology Co., Ltd, of China.

Hazards.Name: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. In addition, the XT016 model adult bed rail does not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing entrapment hazards, and its push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard.

Images.Caption: Recalled Xentrawave Adult Portable Bed Rail, model XT016
Recalled Xentrawave Adult Portable Bed Rail, model XT016
Recalled Xentrawave Adult Portable Bed Rail, model XT026, batch 20251212
Recalled Xentrawave Adult Portable Bed Rail Label, model XT026, batch 20251212

Importers.Name: Guangzhouyupinkejiyouxiangongsi (Guangzhou Yupin Technology Co., Ltd) dba Xentrawave, of China

Injuries.Name: CPSC has received one report of a death involving the Xentrawave adult portable bed rail, model XT016. In 2026, an 89-year-old woman died from asphyxiation after she became entrapped between the bed rail and mattress.

Manufacturers.Name: Guangzhou Nanyu Medical Technology Co., Ltd, of China.

Products.Name: Xentrawave XT016 and XT026 Adult Portable Bed Rails

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails immediately and contact Xentrawave for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the foam padding on the bed rail handle grips, take a photo of the destroyed bed rail and email the photo to xentrawavedirect@163.com or submit it online at https://xentrawahelp.com/xentrawave-bed-rail-safety-recall/.

items.product_description: FP3D Light Reddish Pink;  Model/Catalog Number: 4230441;  Product Description: The FP3D is designed for additive manufacturing on Carbon 3D printers (wavelength = 385 nm). FP3D is intended to be used within a computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM) digital dentistry system that includes a 3D scanner, design software, 3D printer, post-cure unit (wavelength = 385-405 nm), and post-cure oven for the fabrication of flexible partial dentures for partially edentulous patients.  The device is manufactured using dual-cure technology. The resin consists of two parts (Part A and Part B) that are mixed just before printing. Part A is a UV-curable resin, and Part B is a cross-linking diamine agent. When mixed, the resin undergoes free radical polymerization initiated by a photo-initiator in the presence of a UV light source during the 3D printing process. After printing, the device is then thermally cured in an oven to complete polymerization.
items.reason_for_recall: Some resin cartridges may have been filled without Part B resin. If an affected cartridge is used, the resin may look discolored when dispensed or after post-curing and printed parts may be less flexible and durable.

items.product_description: FP3D Dark Veined;  Model/Catalog Number: 4220442  Product Description: The FP3D is designed for additive manufacturing on Carbon 3D printers (wavelength = 385 nm). FP3D is intended to be used within a computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM) digital dentistry system that includes a 3D scanner, design software, 3D printer, post-cure unit (wavelength = 385-405 nm), and post-cure oven for the fabrication of flexible partial dentures for partially edentulous patients.  The device is manufactured using dual-cure technology. The resin consists of two parts (Part A and Part B) that are mixed just before printing. Part A is a UV-curable resin, and Part B is a cross-linking diamine agent. When mixed, the resin undergoes free radical polymerization initiated by a photo-initiator in the presence of a UV light source during the 3D printing process. After printing, the device is then thermally cured in an oven to complete polymerization.
items.reason_for_recall: Some resin cartridges may have been filled without Part B resin. If an affected cartridge is used, the resin may look discolored when dispensed or after post-curing and printed parts may be less flexible and durable.
